'''''Agrostis canina''''', the '''velvety [[bentgrass]]''',<ref>{{Cite book|url=http://www.forest.go.kr/kna/special/download/English_Names_for_Korean_Native_Plants.pdf |title=English Names for Korean Native Plants |publisher=[[Korea National Arboretum]] |year=2015 |isbn=978-89-97450-98-5 |location=Pocheon |page=344 |access-date=25 January 2016 |via=[[Korea Forest Service]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170525105020/http://www.forest.go.kr/kna/special/download/English_Names_for_Korean_Native_Plants.pdf |archive-date=25 May 2017 }}</ref> '''brown bent''' or '''velvet bent''',<ref name="Penn">{{cite book|author=Ann Fowler Rhoads|title=The Plants of Pennsylvania: an Illustrated Manual|author2=Timothy A. Block|author3=Anna Aniśko|publisher=[[University of Pennsylvania Press]]|year=2007|isbn=978-0-8122-4003-0|edition=2nd|pages=322 326|chapter=''Agrostis'' L.|author-link=Ann Fowler Rhoads|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=TUVxB7goeV0C&pg=PA323|name-list-style=amp}}</ref> is a species of grass in the family [[Poaceae]].

==Description==
[[File:Agrostis.canina.jpg|thumb|left|upright|Inflorescence]]
''Agrostis canina'' is a [[perennial plant]], with [[stolon]]s but no [[rhizome]]s, and [[culm (botany)|culms]] which grow to a height of up to {{convert|75|cm}}.<ref name="Stace">{{cite book |author=Clive A. Stace |author-link=Clive A. Stace |year=2010 |title=[[New Flora of the British Isles]] |edition=3rd |publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]] |isbn=978-0-521-70772-5 |chapter= ''Agrostis'' L. – Bents |pages=1026–1030}}</ref> It is frequently confused with ''[[Agrostis vinealis]]'' (formerly treated as a [[subspecies]] or [[Variety (botany)|variety]] of ''A. canina''), which grows in more upland habitats and has rhizomes rather than stolons.<ref name="Penn"/>

The leaf blades are {{convert|2|-|15|cm|1|abbr=on}} long and {{convert|1|-|3|mm|2|abbr=on}} wide,<ref name="Hubbard"/> with an acute or acuminate [[ligule]] up to {{convert|4|mm|abbr=on}} long.<ref name="Stace"/>

The plant flowers from May to July,<ref name="Penn"/> and the [[inflorescence]] is a [[panicle]] {{convert|3|-|16|cm|abbr=on}} long and up to {{convert|7|cm|abbr=on}} wide, with rough branches.<ref name="Hubbard"/> Each [[spikelet]] is {{convert|1.9|-|2.5|mm|2|abbr=on}} long; the [[Lemma (botany)|lemma]] is {{convert|1.6|mm|abbr=on}} long with an [[Awn (botany)|awn]] attached around the middle.<ref name="Penn"/>

==Distribution and ecology==
The [[range (biology)|range]] of ''Agrostis canina'' covers most of Europe and [[temperate climate|temperate]] parts of Asia, and extends from sea level to the [[alpine tundra|alpine zone]].<ref name="Peeters">{{cite web |url=http://www.fao.org/ag/AGP/AGPC/doc/Gbase/DATA/pf000417.htm |title=''Agrostis canina'' L. |work=Grassland Spsecies Profiles |author=Alain Peeters |publisher=[[Food and Agriculture Organization]] |access-date=February 14, 2011 |archive-date=June 28, 2011 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110628183053/http://www.fao.org/ag/AGP/AGPC/doc/Gbase/DATA/pf000417.htm }}</ref> It has also been introduced to eastern North America, [[Hawaii|Hawai{{okina}}i]], [[Algeria]] and the [[Kerguelen Islands]].<ref name="iucn status 20 November 2021" />

''Agrostis canina'' is sensitive to drought,<ref name="Peeters"/> but is common in damp places, including ditches and lake margins.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.plant-identification.co.uk/skye/gramineae/agrostis-canina-ss.htm |title=Velvet Bent. ''Agrostis canina'' s.s. |work=West Highland Flora |author=Carl Farmer |access-date=February 14, 2011 |archive-date=September 25, 2006 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060925084955/http://www.plant-identification.co.uk/skye/gramineae/agrostis-canina-ss.htm }}</ref>

The short, green growth of ''A. canina'' has made it popular as a [[lawn grass]].<ref name="Hubbard">{{cite book |author=C. E. Hubbard |author-link=Charles Edward Hubbard |year=1984 |edition=3rd |title=Grasses: a Guide to their Structure, Identification, Uses and Distribution in the British Isles |publisher=[[Penguin Books]] |isbn=978-0-14-013227-4 |chapter=Velvet bent – ''Agrostis canina'' L. subsp. ''canina'' |pages=294–295}}</ref>
